card.name: Length measures before thick, wide, high
card.fires_on: The number or unit (feet, meters, ft, or closing bracket) of a physical dimension, right where an adjective like thick, wide, tall or high is about to come. Seen in general web text about walls, ice, trees and structures.

card.writes: It favors dimension-type continuations and discourages words about estates and grounds.
